faq.a: Altus at 1526 Finlay Street was built 2022 by Oviedo Developments, per the MLS® strata building record.
Altus is 13 storeys with 126 apartments (16 rental).
A clubhouse, exercise room, bike room and concierge.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Building facts from the City of White Rock info sheets and the MLS® strata building records, read November 14, 2026. Live search: Gerry’s 1452100.
